summary: Iter 356 — Employee-Wise Yearly Payroll Register (Bonus-Register-style). Both backend (8/8 pytest pass) and frontend (Expo web) tested end-to-end for Kankani Enterprises (cmp_527fecdd7c, FY 2026). All acceptance criteria met: JSON shape (127 employees, 12 months Apr-26..Mar-27, months_covered contains 2026-04..2026-07), pagination (skip=0 vs skip=5 disjoint), status/department filters, multi-FY (24 months), auth 401, XLSX 200 (>20KB), PDF 200 (>50KB). Frontend UI: employee blocks render with month columns + salary head rows + EMPLOYEE TOTAL line, GRAND TOTAL card at bottom, Prev/Next pagination works (Page 1/13 → 2/13 with different employees), FY dropdown switches years, PDF (181KB) and XLSX (97KB) downloads trigger correctly. Minor testability issue: `<select>` filters on web use `testID` prop directly on native `<select>` — React DOM does not translate testID→data-testid, so pr-fy/pr-years/pr-status are not selectable by data-testid (they exist and work via onChange). No functional bug.

react_native_issues.issue: Native HTML <select> elements (Platform.OS==='web') use `testID` prop which React DOM does not recognize and strips (console warning: 'React does not recognize the testID prop on a DOM element'). Should use `data-testid={...}` for HTML elements instead of `testID`. Affected: pr-fy (line 189), pr-years (line 204), pr-status (line 219). Reference: /app/frontend/app/payroll-register.tsx:188-231. Does not affect functionality — UI works — but blocks automated testing of these filters via testID.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: In /app/frontend/app/payroll-register.tsx replace `testID="pr-fy"`, `testID="pr-years"`, `testID="pr-status"` on the raw <select> elements with `data-testid="pr-fy"` etc. (or wrap them in a component that does the mapping). This is a testability improvement only; the feature works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: payroll_register.py (604 lines) is above the 700-line soft cap threshold but still within limit — acceptable. Consider splitting _build_xlsx and _build_pdf into separate modules if it grows further.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projections. Auth enforced via require_role. Env vars respected. Good.
Response uses proper streaming for xlsx/pdf with correct MIME types.
